# Strategy -- rules and checks (generated from strategy.json; do not edit)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **status** | generated by build_kit.py; source of record is `angles/strategy.json` |
| **updated** | on every `build_kit.py` run |
| Purpose | Say where this sits, what it replaces, and confirm the department it was already filed under. |
| Artifact | the Strategy rows of APP.md; no code and no second file |

## Questions

| id | question | required for | optional | v1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S1 | What do you do today without it? | page, chat | no | prefilled |
| S2 | Does it replace or extend something you already have? Name it, or say nothing. | page, chat, link | no | prefilled |
| S3 | It files under <department> - <charter title>: <charter purpose>. Keep it there, or move it? | page, chat, link | no | yes |
| S4 | Anything you would want to track about it over time? | - | yes | no |

## Rules

| id | rule | kinds | Sutra source | enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ST-1 | The department is stated, never interviewed. The chat prints the pinned department with its charter title and purpose and offers only keep or move; a move goes through the assign action. The pin travels as the pin option on the session call, never as seed text. | page, chat, link | ADR-028 placement; static/js/18-modules.js pin option | classify pin; C6 |
| ST-2 | Only the department ref is persisted. An unknown ref reads as Unassigned, never as the root. | page, chat, link | schemas/app-manifest.schema.json department | server normalize on read; C6 |
| ST-3 | The charter title and purpose are quoted from the registry, never written by the chat. No charter means the row says 'no charter yet'. | page, chat, link | org_api.py charters | C6, which skips with a note when the registry cannot be read |
| ST-4 | 'Replaces or extends' names an existing app, or a non-app thing in plain words, or says nothing. Naming an existing app offers to archive it; archive is a status change. | page, chat, link | app-manifest.schema.json status; 2026-09-08-modules-design.md | C9 (advisory); archive is a structured change in the edit chat |
| ST-5 | Review is a date and only a date. No owner is invented, no reminder is scheduled, no meeting is created. | page, chat, link | sutra-defaults.json (no operational capacity for human rituals) | C7 parses the date; nothing schedules anything |
| ST-6 | Publishability is a yes/no/not sure answer. The chat never asks for semver, author, license or homepage and never writes a publish block. | page, chat, link | ADR-039 Decision; app-manifest.schema.json publish; APPS-THREATS.md X-9 | C8 |

## Checks

| id | level | kinds | v1 | what | evaluator |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| C6 | required | page, chat, link | must-fix | The Department row names a ref that equals module.json department.ref, and its charter text equals the registry's title and purpose. | ref matches ^dref-[0-9a-f]{16}$ and equals the manifest value; direct placement_engine import reads the charter registry from disk (the same file read modules_api.py uses); registry unreadable or no charter returns SKIP 'charter not read', never FAIL; no department passes when the row reads Unassigned; a row that names a department while the manifest has none FAILs (assign it, or write Unassigned) |
| C7 | required | page, chat, link | must-fix | The P6 answer carries a date that parses as YYYY-MM-DD and is not earlier than created_at. | pattern plus date compare against module.json created_at |
| C8 | required | page, chat, link | suggest | The chat authored no publish block. | publish absent or null passes; a server-owned publish.state of exported or imported passes; any other authored publish keys FAIL naming them |
| C9 | advisory | page, chat, link | suggest | When S2 names an app id, that folder exists; WARN when the replaced app is still status ready. | when the cell matches ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,40}$ stat <home>/<id>/module.json and read status; plain words pass |
